top_signals.title: Binance Faces New Scrutiny in Its Crypto-Friendly UAE Haven
top_signals.summary: Police inquiries involving Binance Holdings Ltd. employees in the United Arab Emirates are testing the crypto exchange in a country that has become one of its most important bases, after investigators scrutinized a bank account it uses to hold customer money.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Lawmakers call for investigation into impact of CISA staffing cuts
top_signals.summary: Lawmakers say little is known about how recent cuts have impacted CISA and how the knowledge that was lost has been replaced.
